to share his latest thoughts on when investors should consider buying SpaceX shares, suggesting they wait for the stock to fall below $100.
“My answer has been: Wait until the SPCX price drops below $100/share, which will likely happen once SPCX makes an all-equity offer to merge with TSLA,” Black wrote.

Assuming SpaceX offers Tesla shareholders a 25% premium, Black estimates the transaction would require issuing 52% more shares, valuing the combined company at approximately $1.9 trillion on a pro forma basis, or $481 per Tesla share.
Black also expects at least 12 months between the announcement and completion of the transaction. During that period, merger arbitrage investors could short shares of

He believes the resulting selling pressure could eventually eliminate the premium offered to Tesla shareholders.
